title: Clinical records
empty: No clinical records have been entered.
noEncounters: Record an encounter before adding a clinical record.
selectRecipients: Guardians who can see this version
noGuardians: Link a guardian’s account to share this version.
staleGuardians: Guardian links have changed. Refresh before editing access.
sharingHint: Clear a guardian’s selection to withdraw access.
labPrivate: Review the result before granting guardian access.
correctionHint: Saving keeps all previous versions in the history and withdraws guardian access. You can share the new version after saving.
reviewHint: Confirm the result shown above. This records your identity and review time.
invalid: Check the clinical fields and date. Enter a unique local time in the displayed time zone.
conflict: This record has changed. Refresh and review the latest version.
missing: This patient or record is unavailable.
denied: Your account cannot access this patient or record.
uncertain: The save could not be confirmed. Retry the same submission.
author: Staff account
admissionConflict: The admission could not be saved. Refresh the chart and check whether this patient already has an active stay.
summaryHint: After you release this version, the selected guardians can see its status and this summary.
summaryRelease: Selected guardians can see the final status and guardian summary. The clinical notes are private to the clinic.
privateStage: Visible to clinic staff. Guardian access can be granted when this record is finalized.
activeStayHint: Each patient can have one active stay. Ward, location and inpatient notes remain private to the clinic.
activeSurgeryHint: The surgical plan and notes are private to the clinic.
stageHint: This action adds a dated entry to the version history.
releasedSummary: Final status and guardian summary shared with {names}.
